minimumCoreLoop: Enter a shared social space, choose an avatar identity or role, and pick a short activity, location, or interaction goal with other players.
Perform roleplay activities, jobs, collection, customization, or social interactions that produce visible rewards and identity feedback.
Use rewards to expand avatar, home, vehicle, or social expression options, then choose a new roleplay goal or group activity in the same persistent world.

Complete the round or score target, receive progression or loadout rewards, and re-enter a new match with a changed tactical choice or mastery goal.

Finish or fail the round, receive score or cosmetic progression, then retry quickly or rotate into a different minigame pattern with minimal downtime.
